name: Toe Yoga

instructions.description: Sit or stand with the whole foot supported.
Lift the big toe while keeping the other toes down.
Lower it, then lift the other toes while the big toe stays down.
Alternate slowly without curling the toes forcefully.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Toe Yoga — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Toe Yoga — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Perform seated if standing balance is limited.
